en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 15.One of our companions narrated from Jābir ibn Sadīr, from Muʿādh ibn Muslim who said, “

I went to meet Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) while there was a man with him, and [I heard that] Abū ʿAbdullāh (a) told him, ‘The Messenger of Allah (ṣ) said, “Gentle kindness is propitious, whereas roughness is inauspicious.”’”
